guards._rule: Written and committed BEFORE the run. Read from captures/gi-reproj-guards/report.json (scripts/qa/pan_artifacts.py), burst serials 92002 off-a, 92003 mv-sample, 92004 prev-guard, 92005 off-b; 92001 calibrates. rate_edge = effects.gi_luma.edge_pixel_frames / edge_scored_pixel_frames; rate_inner = (pixel_frames - edge_pixel_frames) / (scored - edge_scored), scored = valid samples of the burst; spread = |off-b - off-a|. Direction-only predictions: no offline model of pan transients exists (the replay pack is one static frame).

gi_luma.rate_edge.predicted: below min(off-a, off-b) by more than the off spread
gi_luma.rate_edge.why: main reads another surface's last-frame radiance for rays whose hit was off screen last frame; those sit in the edge band (edge_band: one frame of motion + 1 px) and recover within 1-3 frames, the transient the detector counts

gi_luma.rate_inner.why: away from the edge the reprojection stays on screen: the guard rejects nothing (S8 replay pack, static: giRaw fnv1a a54c4dfd1cc9acb9 with and without the define)

gi_luma.mean.why: a rejected ray takes its next tier (hidden-hit fallback), same expected value

gi trace GPU ms.why: no extra rays; one more compare per screen hit

gi_luma.rate_edge.why: positions off the image are rejected before the floor

gi_luma.rate_inner.predicted: at most max(off-a, off-b); a decrease only at depth edges
gi_luma.rate_inner.why: the motion vector now belongs to the depth-tested sample; inside a surface MVs of a 2x2 block are equal

gi_luma.mean.why: rejected history falls back to the fresh sample

common.energy: Static pre-post float scene mean in dumps.json, within same-run OFF-repeat noise; never PNG/bloom mean.
common.costs: CPU ms normalized by presents/draws/builds; frame time recorded but not judged unfocused. GPU pass ms within OFF repeat uncertainty.
common.restoration: All experimental CPU/GI/generated keys 0; qa_exposure_hold and diagnostics 0; runner restores original INI on all exit paths.
